files.home/config.yaml:
server:
  port: {port}
backends:
  pools:
    - {id: probe-pool, label: Probe Pool, rule: rotate, members: [probe-a, probe-b]}
  calls:
    worker: probe-pool
    improve: probe-pool
    verify: probe-pool
    review: probe-pool
    cold_read: probe-pool
    probe: probe-pool
    autoname: probe-pool
    triage: probe-pool
  options:
    - id: probe-a
      label: Probe A
      type: cc-claude
      model: claude-probe-a
    - id: probe-b
      label: Probe B
      type: cc-claude
      model: claude-probe-b

expect.stderr:
attempt probe-a failed: RuntimeError: claude CLI failed (exit 1): boom
attempt probe-b failed: RuntimeError: claude CLI failed (exit 1): boom
